historical_context.time_period: Undated ordinary Zyphos ecology during a daily eclipse; no civilizational era is asserted.
historical_context.location: A sub-Umbros stone saddle where an Umbros-facing lantern-tree grove, candle fungal road, glassback shelter hollow, threadwing route, and prismwake wetland meet.
historical_context.summary: A lantern tree discovers that its eastern light knots are replaying incompatible route signals during eclipse ingress and must decide whether to cut tissue, transfer route authority, maintain a bounded lane, or close the grove while every dependent neighbor repositions.

public_facts.text: Lantern trees provide scarce route light, pollinator timing, young-grazer shelter, and neighborhood taxation during eclipse ingress.
Candle roads and threadwings depend on lantern-tree exchange but retain their own route authority, preferences, and sanctions.
A knot-blight signal cannot identify one cause by itself; the observed failure may mix incompatible memory traffic, tissue hunger, root damage, or courier and fungal carriage.
Glassback shelter pressure and prismwake exclusion turn route closure into trophic and spatial consequences before they can become abstract policy.

ambient_pressures.text: The eclipse is predictable but the useful response window is short, and emergency light spends energy needed for later growth.
Containment preserves archive integrity only by withdrawing light, nectar, route continuity, or shelter from other parties.
Any neighbor that carries traffic around the failed grove also gains credit, testimony, and bargaining leverage over the route's future shape.

groups.label: Eclipse-saddle lantern grove
institutional_logic: Convert scarce stored energy into trustworthy route light while protecting root integrity and layered memory.
material_incentives: Keep pollination, root sugars, route traffic, shelter exchange, and archive continuity solvent across repeated eclipses.
internal_shames: Closure that pretends not to export harm
prestige_markers: Young grazers sheltered without root damage
emotional_display_norms: Pressure becomes knot color, canopy darkness, root tremor, pollen release, bitter mist, and selective illumination.
trust_defaults: Material history and repeated conduct matter more than a single urgent signal.

groups.label: Threadwing, glassback, and lattice-ant route parties
institutional_logic: Protect viable cargo, young bodies, colony brood, and route reputation by moving toward trustworthy signals and away from uncompensated risk.
material_incentives: Gain nectar, shelter, safe passage, sugar, diagnostic payment, and reliable timing while avoiding contamination and injury.
internal_shames: Selling certainty the evidence cannot support
prestige_markers: A herd that moves as one heat body
A diagnostic that changes a real boundary
emotional_display_norms: Alarm appears as vane spread, refusal to land, plate darkening, calf rings, ant glyphs, and abrupt route change.
trust_defaults: Trust follows repeated safe exchanges and can move to a neighboring provider within one eclipse.

groups.label: Candle-road and prismwake junction
institutional_logic: Keep nutrient and traffic exchange useful without absorbing contamination, trampling, or unpaid displacement.
material_incentives: Receive root sugar, spores, careful grazing, clean dead matter, and trustworthy reports while preserving regrowth tissue.
internal_shames: A road becoming a contamination vector
A detour that has no safe destination
prestige_markers: Mats that reopen after return light
Traffic that pays without tearing tissue
emotional_display_norms: The road dims, detours, sours, or raises bitter beads; mats fold, flash, slick, and reprice sugar.
trust_defaults: Both parties treat testimony as interested evidence and price traffic accordingly.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A grove must make darkness legible enough to protect memory without pretending route, shelter, and pollination obligations disappear.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Give the tree choices among warning, isolation, energy expenditure, memory loss, and authority transfer; exclude costless closure.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Neighbors depend on the grove but can shift traffic, testimony, pollination, and shelter debt to another provider when its signals become unsafe.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make every supportive act also a bargaining move that changes who owns the route after the emergency.

target_self_read: Couriers, parents, colonies, and route holders protecting their own cargo and dependents
misread_patterns: Treating herd pressure as mere congestion
Treating paid diagnostics as neutral truth
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep the tree's interpretations tied to visible motion, chemical traces, and prior contracts rather than private motive access.

target_self_read: Archive body attempting to remain itself while continuing public work
misread_patterns: Treating protective branch shedding as dumped waste
Treating emergency light as proof of safety
Treating old credit as consent to new risk
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Make road and mat responses materially precise but uninterested in preserving the tree's preferred self-story.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A producer-archive whose body is both the failing infrastructure and the authority deciding how much of itself to quarantine, feed, expose, or cut.
obligations: Account for shelter and route dependents

role_pressure_fields.summary: A neighboring organism or route that can preserve traffic during the failure and thereby inherit credit, access, or authority.
obligations: Carry only the risk its contract admits
failure_modes: Exporting traffic into another closed niche

known_context.text: The tree knows its knot timing, stored energy, cambium reports, root pressure, pollen taste, fungal messages, infant distress chemistry, and prior local contracts.

beliefs.text: The tree treats trustworthy light and explicit darkness as forms of route law for which its body remains accountable.

misreads.text: The tree may mistake neighbors' rapid repositioning for betrayal when they are protecting cargo, calves, brood, or regrowth tissue.

must_not_know.text: The tree must not know the single cause of the syndrome, the private intentions of mobile partners, or whether a containment decision succeeded before their visible responses arrive.

author_only_boundaries.text: Knot blight remains a field label for a visible failure pattern, not a canonized pathogen species or complete disease taxonomy.
The eclipse saddle and its particular tree, courier, herd, road segment, ant colony, and mat are story-local instances rather than named vault canon.

open_questions.question: Which distinct biological causes can produce the knot-blight syndrome, and which are transmissible across courier, fungal, and root channels?
open_questions.notes: The fixture deliberately preserves diagnostic uncertainty; a future disease ecology pass could split causes without changing this observed emergency pattern.

open_questions.question: How long can lantern-tree knots sustain emergency light before later growth, reproduction, or archive maintenance fails?
open_questions.notes: The fixture uses coarse stored-energy pressure rather than inventing a quantitative budget.

open_questions.question: What local-language names distinguish truthful closure, emergency route light, and contaminated invitation among different lantern groves?
open_questions.notes: Names remain for Weksa; the fixture uses descriptive translation handles only.
